label: Kahlin Compound and Half-Caste Home
summary: Darwin compound where removed children were kept in dormitories; inmates moved to Bagot in 1939.

label: The Bungalow (Alice Springs)
summary: Home for removed children in Stuart, moved to Jay Creek (1928) and Temple Bar (1932).

label: Retta Dixon Home
summary: Darwin home opened after the war with 51 children, peaking at 120.

label: Removal to southern states
summary: Children evacuated south in 1942; from 1955 the Commonwealth sent part-Aboriginal children to southern foster homes and schools.

label: Rations and stolen wages
summary: Aboriginal stock workers paid in rations or below award; paying more than a set amount was illegal until 1968.

label: CDEP (community-run work)
summary: Community Development Employment Projects, run by communities; abolished by the Intervention.

label: Compulsory income management
summary: Half of welfare quarantined on a card; extended to 2033.

label: CDP and RJED remote jobs
summary: Community Development Program penalties, replaced by RJED from November 2025.

label: Dispossession for pastoral runs
summary: Land taken for pastoral leases; Aboriginal people confined to reserves and stations.

label: Land Rights Act and land councils
summary: Over 50% of NT land and 85% of its coastline is Aboriginal land.

label: Compulsory five-year leases
summary: Intervention leases over township land.

label: Aboriginal ranger grants
summary: NT ranger grants, $12M over four years, dropped in 2025.

label: Territory Coordinator
summary: Power to fast-track projects and override NT laws including the Heritage Act.

label: Beetaloo gas
summary: Fracking exploration with public grants; native title holders object.

label: Reserves and confinement
summary: People moved onto government settlements and reserves.

label: Remote overcrowding
summary: 54% of remote community houses overcrowded (2022).

label: Remote housing agreements
summary: Joint Commonwealth-NT housing deals; $4B agreement from 2024, behind schedule.

label: Remote rent and tenants' rights
summary: Remote Rent Framework struck down in Badari (2025); NT amends the Housing Act.

label: Short-stay shelter and evacuation
summary: Flood evacuations to Darwin; YiSSA closure in 2026.

label: Rheumatic heart disease
summary: 1 in 17 First Nations Territorians live with RHD or ARF history (2024).

label: Life expectancy
summary: Aboriginal Territorians live 13.5 to 13.8 years less than non-Indigenous Territorians.

label: Childhood hearing loss
summary: 94% of Aboriginal prisoners tested had significant hearing loss.

label: Alcohol floor price
summary: $1.30 minimum unit price, scrapped February 2025.

label: Rehab and sobering-up
summary: Darwin's only residential rehab and sobering-up shelter closed 2024; parole rehab cut.

label: Bilingual education
summary: Cut or targeted in 1980, 1998, 2008 and 2024; 21 schools in 1991, eight now.

label: Funding by attendance
summary: 'Effective enrolment' sent money away from Aboriginal students.

label: Attendance
summary: Schools reached Aboriginal students 54.7% of the time in 2025.

label: Truancy fines and income referrals
summary: Parents fined or referred to income management.

label: Chief Protector guardianship
summary: Chief Protector legal guardian of every Aboriginal child to 18; control of women for life (1918).

label: Wardship (Welfare Ordinance)
summary: Director of Welfare guardian of all 'wards'; 15,711 named on the 1957 register.

label: Child Placement Principle
summary: In NT law since 1983; applies only 'as far as practicable' from 2026.

label: Kin placement
summary: Only 16.7% of children in care placed with kin (2026).

label: Out-of-home care contracts
summary: 93% of $143.4M paid to non-government providers.

label: Mounted police and massacres
summary: Police and settler reprisals, including Daly River (1884) and Coniston (1928).

label: Public drinking offence
summary: Decriminalised in 2019 in line with the Royal Commission; re-criminalised October 2024.

label: Arrests and watch houses
summary: About 40 Aboriginal people a day taken into custody from December 2024.

label: Use of force and weapons
summary: Spit hoods banned 2017, reinstated 2025; armed public safety officers; OC spray legal for the public.

label: Deaths in custody
summary: 634 Indigenous deaths in custody nationally since 1991.

label: Who polices
summary: Ex-military and overseas recruitment.

label: Age of criminal responsibility
summary: 10, raised to 12 in 2023, lowered to 10 in October 2024.

label: Doli incapax (10 to 13)
summary: Children 10-13 presumed incapable of criminal intent, yet remanded.

label: Bail laws
summary: Declan's Law (2024); last-resort principle removed (2025).

label: Remand
summary: Youth remand averages 56 days; 41% of NT prisoners on remand (Nov 2025).

label: Mandatory sentencing
summary: Mandatory jail for property offences, repealed 2001.

label: Genocide in Australian law
summary: Kruger (1997), Nulyarimma (1999), and the Attorney-General's consent gate since 2002.

label: Youth detention
summary: Don Dale footage (2016); Holtze the only youth centre from November 2024.

label: Transfers Alice Springs to Darwin
summary: 60 children moved in 10 months; handcuffed commercial flights.

label: Adult imprisonment
summary: 4,515 per 100,000 Aboriginal adults (June 2026).

label: Programs inside
summary: 10 of 11 drug and alcohol sessions cancelled in six months.

label: Aboriginal legal services (NAAJA)
summary: Represents about 65% of everyone in NT criminal matters; Commonwealth-funded.

label: Aboriginal Interpreter Service
summary: Fills about half of requests; most interpreters casual.

label: Legal Aid NT
summary: Stopped new criminal grants for people not in custody.
